questions.question: A jeep covers a distance of 180 km at a certain speed. If the speed is increased by 15 km/h, it takes 1 hour less. Find the original speed.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of speeds s × (s + 15) = (Distance × Change in Speed) ÷ Change in Time

s × (s + 15) = (180 × 15) ÷ 1 = 2700

Checking factors of 2700 with a difference of 15: 45 × 60 = 2700

The original speed is the smaller factor, s = 45 km/h.

**∴ Answer = 45 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 180 km

Increase in speed = 15 km/h

Decrease in time = 1 hour

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 180 km Case 1: Speed = s Time = 180/s Case 2: Speed = s+15 Time = 180/(s+15) Difference = 1 hour 

**Calculations:**

Let the original speed be s km/h.

⇒ 180/s − 180/(s + 15) = 1

⇒ 180 × [ (s + 15 − s) / (s × (s + 15)) ] = 1

⇒ 180 × 15 = s(s + 15)

⇒ 2700 = s² + 15s

⇒ s² + 15s − 2700 = 0

⇒ s² + 60s − 45s − 2700 = 0

⇒ s(s + 60) − 45(s + 60) = 0

⇒ (s − 45)(s + 60) = 0

⇒ s = 45 or s = −60

Since speed cannot be negative, s = 45 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 45 km/h (Option 1).**

questions.question:
Raju and Pintu together can clean a garden in 10 hours.

If Raju alone can do it in 15 hours, how many hours will Pintu alone take?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When combined time (xy) and one person's time (x) are given, the other's time is (x × xy) ÷ (x − xy).

Individual time for Pintu = (15 × 10) ÷ (15 − 10)

Individual time for Pintu = 150 ÷ 5 = 30 hours.

**∴ Answer = 30 hours**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Raju + Pintu = 10 hours

Time taken by Raju alone = 15 hours

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of individual times; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 
 
•

 Pintu (Eff: 1)
 Total Work = 30 Units (LCM of 10, 15)
 

 Combined Efficiency = 3 units/hr
 Pintu alone = 30 / 1 = 30 hrs

**Calculations:**

Assume Total Work = LCM(10, 15) = 30 units

⇒ Efficiency of (Raju + Pintu) = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Raju = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Pintu = (Raju + Pintu) Efficiency − Raju Efficiency

⇒ Efficiency of Pintu = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/hr

⇒ Time taken by Pintu alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Pintu

⇒ Time taken by Pintu alone = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 30 hours (Option 2).**</p

questions.question: In a right-angled triangle, where is the orthocenter located?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In any right-angled triangle, the two legs are perpendicular to each other.

Each leg serves as the altitude for the opposite vertex.

The altitudes from the two non-right vertices coincide with the legs and meet at the right angle.

Since the orthocenter is the intersection of all altitudes, it must lie at the vertex where the legs meet.

**∴ Answer = At the right-angled vertex**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A right-angled triangle ABC with ∠B = 90°.

**Formula used:**

Orthocenter is the point where all three altitudes of a triangle intersect.
